<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X) / 2. For C₁₁H₁₃O₃, C = 11, H = 13, N = 0, X = 0. DBE = (2·11 + 2 – 13) / 2 = (24 – 13) / 2 = 11 / 2 = 5.5. Since DBE must be reported as an integer, we take the nearest whole number, which is 5.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
